title: PlasmaZones Pointer Shader Metadata
description: metadata.json for a bundled or user pointer shader pack (trails, halos, click ripples, sparks). Core identity and the parameter contract are enforced. Optional placement and multipass keys (layer, reach, reachParam, trailSeconds, needsCursor, multipass, bufferShaders, bufferFeedback, bufferScale, animated, vertexShader, textures), named parameter presets and descriptive metadata (description, author, version, category, preview) are allowed through.

layer.description: Where the pack paints relative to the cursor sprite. below (the default) paints under KWin's cursor and never touches cursor visibility. above hides the cursor while the pack is live and the host paints the sprite itself after the chain.

reach.description: How far (logical px, default 64) from any trail point or press point the pack may paint. The host derives the damage rect from it, so painting outside it gets clipped.

reachParam.description: Name of an int or float parameter whose resolved value replaces reach.

trailSeconds.description: How long (seconds, default 1.0) after the last motion or button event the pack still needs frames. The host keeps repainting for that long, then stops until the next event. This is a liveness figure and nothing else. What spaces the history's samples is how far back the pack READS, which defaults to this but should be declared separately through trailWindowParam or trailWindowSeconds whenever the two differ.

trailWindowSeconds.description: How far back (seconds) the pack's stages actually read the trail, when that is a fixed figure rather than a slider. Defaults to trailSeconds. This is what spaces the history's slots, so a pack that needs frames for two seconds but only ever looks at the last half second of path should say so and get a four times finer stroke for it.

trailWindowParam.description: Name of an int or float parameter whose resolved value replaces trailWindowSeconds, the same shape reachParam has over reach. Use it when how far back the pack reads is a slider, such as a trail's lifetime, so shortening the tail buys a finer stroke for it.

samplesTrail.description: Whether any stage reads uPointerTrail. Defaults true. A click pack that draws only at the press point should set it false, so its trailSeconds keeps its own animation running without coarsening the sample spacing of the trail packs beside it.

needsCursor.description: Bind the cursor sprite as uCursorSprite and set uPointerFlags.x to 1.

animated.description: Accepted for parity with the other families and ignored. Pointer packs always tick while live.

presets.description: Named parameter presets. Each value is a map of parameter id to value, naming a subset of the pack's declared parameters. A preset id is its key here and reaches the filesystem as <family>/<id>.json, so it must be a single safe path component.

type.description: Marshalling type of the uniform. An unknown type cannot be bound, so it is rejected. No image type here: the pointer loader refuses one because neither the slot translator nor the preamble maps it, so declare a texture in the top-level textures array instead, where it binds as uTexture<N>.

default.description: Default value. Use a string for color (#aarrggbb), a number for float or int, and a boolean for bool.
